human_hourly_rate.distinction: 20-40 are platform contract summaries; 50.144 and 65.375 derive annual US employee wages / assumed 2080 hours and are not bill rates

software_license_price.fixed_subscription_alternatives: use S04-S07; allocate across actual usage, not invented infinite throughput

unidentified: model authoring and full engineering cost
parameter_guidance.unknowns_policy: These are scenario variables, not calibrated point estimates. Include zero demand/value and competent low-cost competition. Derive break-even surfaces and maximum repayable asset cost rather than calling an arbitrary selected cost measured or bounded.
parameter_guidance.investment_cost: No finite all-in bound is established by wage data alone. If time/model usage are unavailable, label component unknown and report conditional cost thresholds.
parameter_guidance.recurrence: One job requires a changed version, source, consumer scope, or obligation. Rerunning a fixed packet is evaluation/replay, never a newly observed customer mission. Scheduled checks do not automatically imply payable work.
